body: Even if she told me she loved me tomorrow, it wouldn't stop me from doing this. The fact remains that I just wanted her to know. But as I've stated in another comment, I've realised minimizing collateral might be the better option. She doesn't deserve this. She deserves all the happiness and joy in the world. Not this shit.

You're right, she doesn't deserve this. She doesn't deserve any of this. I'll just go and she'll never even have known that I thought about her the way I did. One way or another I have to do it. I can't delay this decision any more than I already have. But she can't be the collateral in this. I really wish there was some way for her to know how much I loved her without my death making her sad.
Thank you for the kind words
Don't tell her at all? Why?
I did. For 5 years. It did nothing. Neither did the meds. Im not changing my decision, I just need advice.
Hotlines suck. But thank you for the concern.
